d: p
The Senior Manager – HR Business Partner acts as a strategic people advisor to senior business leaders, translating business priorities into effective workforce and people strategies.
p

The role partners closely with leadership and HR Centres of Excellence to drive workforce planning, organization effectiveness, talent and succession planning, performance management, employee engagement, change initiatives, and organizational capability while ensuring HR decisions are commercially sound and aligned with company policies.
p
The Senior Manager level is already established within Qiddiya's HRBP structure, for example Rayan Alharbi holds the title Senior Manager – HR Business Partner
q: Act as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leaders on organizational, workforce, talent, and people-related matters.
Develop a strong understanding of the business strategy, operating model, priorities, and workforce challenges.
Translate business requirements into practical HR strategies and interventions.
Challenge and influence leadership decisions where necessary to ensure effective people and organizational outcomes.

Use workforce data, dashboards, and people metrics to provide actionable insights and support leadership decision-making, consistent with Qiddiya's existing HRBP expectations. [Re: HR Bus...tner roles | Outlook]
Lead strategic workforce and headcount planning for assigned business areas.
Identify current and future capability requirements and workforce gaps.
Advise leadership on organizational structures, spans and layers, role requirements, and workforce optimization.
Partner with Organization Development and relevant HR teams on restructures and organization design initiatives.
Support workforce forecasting and manpower planning in line with business growth and transformation priorities.
Partner with leaders to identify critical roles, high-potential employees, and succession requirements.
Facilitate talent reviews, succession planning, and development discussions.
Identify capability gaps and work with Talent Management and Learning & Development to establish appropriate interventions.
Support leadership in building strong internal talent pipelines and improving retention of critical capabilities.
Guide leaders through goal setting, performance reviews, calibration, and performance improvement processes.
Facilitate effective performance and talent discussions with senior leadership teams.
Support managers in addressing underperformance and establishing appropriate Performance Improvement Plans.
Promote a strong performance culture based on accountability, transparency, and continuous feedback.
Provide guidance on complex and sensitive employee relations matters.
Partner with relevant HR specialists on disciplinary cases, grievances, workplace concerns, and other employee matters.
Analyze engagement feedback and workforce trends to identify organizational issues and recommend interventions.
Coach managers on effective people management and employee engagement.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Organizational Development , or a related discipline.
Professional HR certification such as CIPD, SHRM-SCP, SPHR/HRCI , or equivalent is preferred.
Strong knowledge of Saudi labor regulations and HR practices.
12+ years of progressive HR experience , with significant experience in an HR Business Partnering capacity.
Demonstrated experience partnering with senior executives and business leaders.
Strong experience in workforce planning, organization design, talent and succession management, performance management, employee relations, and change management .
Experience supporting large, complex, or rapidly transforming organizations.
Experience within development, construction, engineering, real estate, infrastructure, entertainment, or other large-scale project environments is highly desirable.

d: p
Red Hat's Technical Services team is looking for an experienced, enterprise-level engineer to join us as a OpenShift Technical Account Manager (TAM).
p
In this role, you'll work with a small set of key customers to provide hands-on technical and architectural guidance for the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.
p

At Red Hat, customer support includes far more than just “break-fix” solutions. Customers get industry-leading resources that enable their technical environments to run efficiently, so they can focus on growing their businesses.
p
Technical account management is a premium support offering that builds, maintains, and grows long-lasting customer loyalty between Red Hat and our customers.
p

You will forge relationships with your customers, develop a deep technical understanding of their Red Hat implementation, share technical best practices and act as point of contact for any major incidents, managing the customer’s expectations and communications through resolution of such incidents.
p

You will tailor support for each customer's environment, facilitate collaboration with their other vendors and advocate on their behalf. At the same time, you'll work closely with our Engineering, Research and Development, Product Management, and Global Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues.
p

The ideal TAM is a team player, enjoys working hard, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, building relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, is able to learn new technologies quickly and uses their time efficiently.
q: 5 years experience in a support, development, engineering, or quality assurance organisation
Expertise with enterprise cloud solutions like Platform-as-a-Service (OpenShift by Red Hat), containers, Kubernetes, cloud management, and IT automation (Ansible Automation Platform by Red Hat)
Ability to manage and grow existing enterprise customer relationships by delivering proactive, relationship-based support
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills; ability to convey complex information to customers clearly and concisely
Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers
Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with an eye for detail
Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors
Good verbal and written communication skills in French
The Following Are Considered a Plus
Experience in system management, cloud or server virtualization
Bachelor's degree in a technology-related discipline, preferably computer science or engineering
Prior experience in a technical leadership or mentorship role
Experience with training and presentation delivery

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
